recommendation: Implement structured clinical monitoring and education for asthma patients
implementation_steps: Provide regular follow-ups to monitor asthma control using validated tools like the Asthma Control Test (ACT) or Asthma Control Questionnaire (ACQ)
Educate patients on proper inhaler techniques with demonstration and return demonstration
Promote adherence to controller medications through education and follow-up
Teach specific strategies for identifying and avoiding personal asthma triggers
Assist in implementing multicomponent allergen-specific mitigation measures for patients with allergen-triggered asthma
evidence_summary: Nurse-led monitoring and education interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in asthma control, proper inhaler technique, medication adherence, and reduced emergency department visits across multiple systematic reviews.
citation: Self-Management Interventions to Reduce Healthcare Use and Improve Quality of Life Among Patients With Asthma: Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis. (2020)
